notes.claim: A 3 by 3 determinant is the sum of each first-row element times its cofactor.
The cross product is the determinant of a 3 by 3 matrix, an easier way to remember its components.
Symmetrical components split an unbalanced set of three phasors into three balanced sets.

sources.quote: obtained by multiplying each element of the first row by its corresponding cofactor and then adding the three together
